howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能为 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 云 API 通道：它会复制适配器文件、注册模块、安装固定版本依赖并运行构建测试，随后引导你配置 Meta 的凭据和 Webhook。
howto.when: 当用户要求连接 WhatsApp、添加 WhatsApp 云通道，或把 NanoClaw 接入官方 Meta API 时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 NanoClaw 连接到 WhatsApp 云 API
say.note: Claude 开始复制文件和装依赖。

say.text: 添加一个 WhatsApp Cloud 通道
say.note: 会修改代码并提示需要的凭据。

say.text: 我要用官方 Meta 接口接入 WhatsApp 消息
say.note: Claude 将引导你走完整个流程。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can add a WhatsApp Cloud API channel to NanoClaw: it copies adapter files, registers a module, pins the dependency version, runs build and tests, then walks you through configuring Meta credentials and the webhook.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to connect WhatsApp, add a WhatsApp Cloud channel, or integrate NanoClaw with the official Meta API.

say_en.text: Connect NanoClaw to the WhatsApp Cloud API.
say_en.note: Claude starts copying files and installing dependencies.
It will modify code and ask for credentials.

say_en.text: I want to receive WhatsApp messages via the official Meta API.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through the setup.
